feature: Email harian ke OIC berisi daftar semua furnish berstatus pending (digest, tanpa batas umur X hari)
note: Job 6 di DailyReportJobsScheduler (08:00, enabled=true di cron-schedules-prod.properties) mengirim email daftar semua furnish status P ke furnish.notification.officer.emails. Mirip OCMS41.35 yang Removed (alert setelah X hari) tapi tanpa filter umur; tidak diklaim. Komentar kode menyebut 41.8 dan 41.35. Pengiriman nyata (email.enableSmtp=false, template PRD) cannot verify from repo.
note_en: Job 6 in DailyReportJobsScheduler (08:00, enabled=true in cron-schedules-prod.properties) emails a list of every furnish with status P to furnish.notification.officer.emails. Similar to OCMS41.35, which is Removed (alert after X days), but without an age filter; not claimed. The code comment mentions 41.8 and 41.35. Real delivery (email.enableSmtp=false, PRD template) cannot be verified from the repo.

feature: Endpoint reject alternatif POST /furnish/officer/reject (FurnishRejectionService) yang tidak dipakai staff portal
note: Implementasi kedua untuk reject: cek status, kirim email ke owner, set status R, panggil resendNoticeToPortal. resendNoticeToPortal adalah stub TODO yang selalu return true. Tidak ada referensi dari ocmsadminui (UI memakai manual-review/reject). Jangan dihitung sebagai bukti resend untuk OCMS41.33.
note_en: A second reject implementation: checks the status, emails the owner, sets status R, calls resendNoticeToPortal. resendNoticeToPortal is a TODO stub that always returns true. Nothing in ocmsadminui references it (the UI uses manual-review/reject). Do not count it as proof of resend for OCMS41.33.
